title: Menstrual Health & Hygiene Awareness Session
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Dahisar successfully organized an impactful Menstrual Health & Hygiene Awareness Session using Menstropedia for girl students of standards 5th to 10th at Vidya Prasarak Mandal School, Dahisar East.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Dahisar successfully organized an impactful Menstrual Health & Hygiene Awareness Session using Menstropedia for girl students of standards 5th to 10th at Vidya Prasarak Mandal School, Dahisar East.
The interactive session was led by Guest Speaker Rtn. Dharti Joshi, District Avenue Chair, who sensitively addressed the young students. She emphasized the critical importance of menstrual hygiene, personal care, and breaking cultural taboos surrounding menstruation, encouraging the girls to build confidence, self-care habits, and a positive mindset.
Club President Rtn. Prakash Kamthe also addressed the gathering, inspiring the students and underscoring the club's ongoing commitment to educating and empowering young girls through meaningful community initiatives.
A Huge Thank You to our Guest Speaker, Rtn. Dharti Joshi, and our wonderful Project Chair Ladies, FL Priya and PE Chetna, for making this project at Vidya Mandir School so meaningful and heart-touching
location: Vidya Mandir School, Dahisar, Mumbai, Maharashtra
